Author: OOFGames
Name: Mini Games Emporium
Punchline: Four live gambling games under one roof, with more on the way.
Description: The all-in-one hosting tool for FFXIV gambling venues, with four live games: BAR 777, Deathroll Tournament, Higher/Lower, and Raffle. Handles player queues, trade verification, boosted pots, ticket draws, automated chat, and a full transaction ledger.
Changelog:
- There is now a webview for deathroll tournament! See video in announcements. - Boosters only while in Beta.
- You can now bet on who will win the deathroll tournament! Hosts can enable this at the start of the session, set a bet cost and optionally a bet keyword to auto capture bets from chat. Whoever bets correctly on the winner takes the betting pool!
- You can now set in-game items or custom items as a prize for winning deathroll tournament. - Due to the change in prize format, custom chat messages for DRT will be reset.
